canon.centralQuestion: Can a sanctuary scale without becoming a prison?
canon.profile: Auren keeps the manor from becoming a beautiful cage. Shelter is his gift, his weapon, and his greatest risk.
canon.duty: Auren decides who gets shelter, what stays hidden, and whether the manor becomes protection or control.
canon.originEvent: A child arrives whom Auren cannot safely turn away. The estate stops being inheritance and becomes a live sanctuary.
canon.mirrorlandFunction: After the manor stands on Audralia, Auren becomes guardian of the place everyone needs and everyone could expose.
canon.specialSkill: turns wealth, land, public misdirection, and room control into a living shield
canon.seasonThread: Auren carries the question of whether a sanctuary can scale without becoming a prison.
